WoW: Forever

Shaman

Forever's Shaman changes are mostly upkeep: weapon imbues last an hour instead of five minutes, buff totems last five minutes and all totems drop on a 1.0-second global cooldown, and a totem bar drops four at once.

WoW: Forever · Updated October 31, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70707 · Null Ossuary

Written for levelling, 1 to 60. The beta closed on October 23 at level 30, so nothing above 30 was tested by players; talents and spells past 30 come from the launch client and Blizzard's posts. Alliance Shaman are new in Forever, and Dwarf is the only Alliance option. Spell tooltips read the base game client and can lag a hotfix, so where one differs from the text here, trust the text.

Shamans cannot dual wield in Forever — no published source grants it, and Blizzard's deep dive never mentions it. If you have played a later expansion, unlearn that.

A widely-published level-30 Elemental build is also not legal on the launch client: it spends 5 points on Elemental FuryElemental FuryTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 100%.. Blizzard moved that talent to row 6 and put it behind Lightning OverloadLightning OverloadTalentCastInstantGives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 30% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat., out of reach at 21 points. That build predates the change.

Blizzard endorses a narrow version of Enhancement tanking. The redesigned Spirit WeaponsSpirit WeaponsTalentCastInstantGives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks, reduces all threat generated by your attacks by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is not active, and increases all threat generated by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is active. keeps the Shaman's "unique ability to generate high threat and serve as a temporary tank in small group gameplay". Improved StormstrikeImproved StormstrikeTalentCastInstantWhen you Stormstrike, you have a 20% chance to gain 50% mana regeneration while casting spells for 15 sec, and Stormstrike's cooldown has a 20% chance to reset each time you Dodge or Parry. is written for "when serving as a temporary tank." Temporary, and small group, is the whole of the sanctioned claim. There is no published tanking build, no raid or dungeon tank role named for Shaman, and no taunt. See Enhancement.

Is Shaman for you?

Play Shaman if you want one character that can heal, cast at range or fight in melee, and you do not mind four class quests gating your totems on the way up.

Blizzard's own summary sets the trade. Shaman "can be effective melee or spell damage dealers and healers of parties or raids" and are "among the sturdiest of classes, with the use of Mail armor and a Shield". But they also "lack an effective crowd control" and "need those allies to make up for their own weaknesses in control and survivability."

Strengths

  • Heals, ranged damage and melee, all from one character
  • Buff totems last 5 minutes and reach 30 yards, and Strength of Earth, Grace of Air, Windfury, Flametongue and the resistance totems cover the whole raid
  • Ghost WolfGhost WolfLevel 20 · Spell · NatureCast3 sec castCost100 ManaDurationUntil cancelledTurns the Shaman into a Ghost Wolf, increasing speed by 40%. Only useable outdoors. at 20 gives 40% run speed, twenty levels before a mount

Weaknesses

  • Mana pays for everything, including every totem you drop
  • Four class quests gate your totems, and one is a two-hour trek
  • No taunt, no defensive cooldown, and no dual wield in Forever

New to this class?

Is the rotation simple? A weapon imbue, Lightning ShieldLightning ShieldLevel 8 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 7CastInstantCost45 ManaDuration600 secThe caster is surrounded by 3 balls of lightning. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 13 Nature damage. This expends one lightning ball. Only one ball will fire every few seconds. Lasts 600 sec., totems, a shock, then swing.

Is it forgiving? You heal yourself, and ReincarnationReincarnationLevel 30 · Spell · NatureCastInstantCooldown3600 sec cooldownAllows you to resurrect yourself upon death with 20% health and mana. at 30 is a self-resurrect. Mail may not arrive until 40, though.

What carries you while levelling? A weapon imbue now lasts an hour instead of five minutes, so a pull costs you nothing but a totem drop.

Does it need a group? No. Each spec can cast, swing and heal itself; the spec pages carry the published levelling ratings and what they measure.

Which race

Read this section in proportion. Race is the smallest of the choices on this page, well behind spec, gear and knowing your rotation, and no race is a wrong answer for levelling (ours, not a source's). Racials decide things in PvP, specifically the ones that break crowd control: Will of the ForsakenWill of the ForsakenTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration0.1 secInstantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects. (Undead, fear, sleep and charm), Escape ArtistEscape ArtistTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration3 secInstantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec. (Gnome, roots and snares) and StoneformStoneformTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration8 secInstantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec. (Dwarf, bleeds, poisons and disease). A free trinket slot is worth more than any damage racial below.

Alliance — Dwarf, and it is forced, being the only Alliance Shaman. StoneformStoneformTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration8 secInstantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec. is a real solo cooldown (ours, not a source's), and Artisan's Precision adds +1% hit with spells and attacks.

Horde — Orc. Blood FuryBlood FuryTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec. gives +10% attack power and spell power for 15 seconds on a 2-minute cooldown, so it serves both damage specs (ours, not a source's).

Tauren: EnduranceEnduranceTalentCastInstantTotal Health increased by 5% and critical strike bonus to damage and healing increased by 2%. is 5% Health and nothing else, and PlainsrunningPlainsrunningTalentCastInstantGain 1% increased movement speed every 5 sec spent moving, up to a maximum of 30% increase. Taking damage or standing still will reduce this effect. In addition, you move 3% faster while mounted. builds 2% run speed a stack to 60% while unmounted, until damage or standing still wears it down. Horde's other new option is Skyborne. Wind BlessedWind BlessedTalentCastInstantIncreases your spellcasting, melee, and ranged Haste by 3%. is a flat +2% haste to melee, ranged and spellcasting alike, and Elemental InsightElemental InsightTalentCastInstantDamage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%. adds +5% damage against Elemental-type enemies, so both apply whichever spec you play. Lasts 30 sec if no elemental convergence is nearby, and 900 sec if one is found. gives 15% run speed for 15 seconds, or 30% while Charged, an hour-long buff from using it at an elemental convergence. Only useable outdoors., so do not pick Skyborne on that (ours, not a source's).

Quality of life

  • The four totem class quests are mandatory and they gate the class. You cannot use any totem of an element until you finish its quest, and each gives you a physical totem item you must keep in your bags. Earth at 4, Fire at 10, Water at 20, Air at 30. The Alliance water chain is new content and takes roughly two hours of running; at least you have Ghost WolfGhost WolfLevel 20 · Spell · NatureCast3 sec castCost100 ManaDurationUntil cancelledTurns the Shaman into a Ghost Wolf, increasing speed by 40%. Only useable outdoors. by then.
  • Do not assume dual wield. No Forever source grants it to Shaman, and one guide explicitly declines to infer it from a removed talent. Blizzard confirms Shield SpecializationShield SpecializationTalent · Rank 5CastInstantDurationUntil cancelledIncreases your chance to block attacks with a shield by 5% and increases the amount blocked by 25%. is removed, so no talent pays for a shield. Blizzard's class summary still counts "Mail armor and a Shield" among Shaman strengths, so carry one for survival rather than damage.
  • Mail armour arrives at 40, not level 1. That is single-sourced and contradicts vanilla, so verify it in game. If it holds, you are a leather-wearer for 39 levels.
  • The Legacy perk PermanencePermanenceTalentCastInstantYour class abilities which grant long-duration stat or attribute benefits to all party or raid members last 100% longer, and the benefits you gain from resting at a camp last 50% longer. doubles long buffs, and reading that onto totems — five minutes becomes ten — is ours, not a source's.

At level 60

No source publishes a Shaman build past 30. The client carries the rest: Elemental MasteryElemental MasteryTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration15 secGain mastery over Fire and Lightning, reducing the cast time of Lightning Bolt and Lava Burst by 0.5 sec, and removing the cooldown from Chain Lightning. Lasts 15 sec., Rage of the FarseerRage of the FarseerTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration25 secIncreases your attack speed by 30% for 25 sec. and RiptideRiptideLevel 40 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost245 ManaRange40 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration15 secHeals a friendly target for 486 to 534, an additional 445 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%. are the 31-point capstones at 40, and rank ladders run to level 60. Shaman has no taunt, no defensive cooldown and no Defense support, so nothing above 30 changes the tanking picture. Raids open December 9.
